_about: (0.4.5, gamefixes: lay the ground for the dungeons of the next update) Every underground place ShadowVeil has a mouth for, as data: what it is ('kind': a monster's 'lair', a working 'mine', a 'hideout', a 'crypt'), the theme its rooms will be built in (rpg.world.DungeonLayout.Theme: CAVE, WARREN, CRYPT, HALL), how many levels deep it is planned to go, and the creatures whose lair it is (rpg.monster.MonsterKind - the same lairs shadowveil.json's fauna names). Bound at load to its structure's mouth and the volume the architecture reserved beyond it (rpg.dungeon.DungeonSites); the next update builds the rooms into those volumes.
